plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Physics-BA-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints 'Physics (BA)'. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. TOTAL AS PRINTED: applying the map's own printed credit rule (5 credits unless a parenthetical number is printed) to every printed cell, this plan sums to 182 credits, NOT 180: the combined general chemistry cell prints '(4 cr)' for the lecture and '(2 cr)' for the lab (6 in all, one entry under the lecture code), and Year 3 Autumn prints FOUR rows including the 1-credit seminar B PHYS 494 ('(C/NC; 1 credit)'), so that quarter sums to 16. Year 3 Winter and Spring also print a fourth row, blank as printed, carrying no course. The over-180 total is transcribed as printed and disclosed here, never smoothed. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Required to apply for major'; the checkmark means 'milestones: Courses & requirements needed to progress'; the four-point marker means 'fulfilled with Discovery Core'; this map prints no star legend. The map's cells print the code form 'B PHYS' while its notes print 'BPHYS' — codes are recorded as printed in the cells and the variant is disclosed here. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (all prerequisites completed, 3.0 grade in each prerequisite, cumulative GPA 3.0; most satisfactory applicants typically but not always admitted) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 1 — Calculus II (STMATH 125) is a prerequisite for Differential Equations (STMATH 207), and STMATH 207 is a prerequisite for BPHYS 222 and BPHYS 221 but may be taken concurrently (the STMATH 207 cell carries the same wording). Year 2 — completion of 200-level Physics (BPHYS 224, 222, 221) and STMATH 207; students are strongly recommended to review 300/400-level Physics elective options for their prerequisites, and additional math may be required. The header also notes some physics electives may require upper-division math not necessarily required for the BA. The fourteen generic 'Elective/Minor Coursework' slots and two 'B PHYS Elective' slots are recorded as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
